name: Giving and removing focus
goal: For fast text to speech, the application requires a hotkey to give focus to the application and remove focus when the user presses the Enter key.

approach.text: As this was not a difficult feature, I thinkered around and found the solution.

normalLearnings: I can give and remove focus from an application.
result: As seen in the video below, the application takes focus using a hotkey and removes focus when the TTS plays.<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/pfxhOhI131w>>
validation: I tested my solution with various other apps and games, all working correctly with my application.
contribution: The automatic focus makes the program more efficient in usage.
